# FREEM ENTERPRISE CO., LTD
> Thai agricultural commodity exporter supplying sugar, rice, fertilizers, edible cooking oil, and energy drinks to global wholesale buyers.

FREEM ENTERPRISE CO., LTD is a B2B export company based in Lampang, Thailand, helping international wholesalers, distributors, and procurement teams source premium agricultural commodities with FOB/CIF shipping and full export documentation.

## Key Pages
- /: Homepage — company overview and product categories
- /products: Full product catalog
- /product-category/sugar: ICUMSA sugar grades from Thailand
- /product-category/rice: Thai jasmine, parboiled, and white rice
- /product-category/fertilizers: NPK, urea, DAP, and organic fertilizers
- /product-category/edible-cooking-oil: Edible cooking oils for export
- /request-a-quote: Wholesale quotation request form
- /contact: Sales contact and company address
- /about-us: Company history, facilities, and export capabilities
- /ordering-procedure: Step-by-step export order process
- /quality-control: Quality assurance and export standards
- /faq: Frequently asked questions for wholesale buyers
- /glossary: Export trade terms (ICUMSA, FOB, CIF, NPK, COA)
- /guides: In-depth export guides for procurement teams

## Primary Topics
- Thai sugar exporter (ICUMSA 45, 100, 150, VHP, brown cane)
- Thailand rice exporter (jasmine, parboiled, white, broken)
- NPK fertilizer supplier Thailand
- Edible cooking oil exporter
- Agricultural commodities wholesale
- FOB and CIF Incoterms for commodity imports
- Export documentation (COA, Certificate of Origin, phytosanitary)
- B2B quote request and container-load export
